SetupWizardWelcomeContent:
This application can receive and display:

- Real-time seismic intensity from the Strong-motion Monitor
- Earthquake Early Warnings via the Strong-motion Monitor, SignalNowProfessional, and DM-D.S.S
- Earthquake Information via the JMA website and DM-D.S.S

Before using the application, customize its features and appearance to suit your needs.

These settings can also be changed from the Settings window after completing this wizard.  
If you are in a hurry, use the “Skip and Start” button.

SetupWizardDmdataContent:
## What is [Project DM-D.S.S](https://dmdata.jp/)?

Project DM-D.S.S is a paid service that distributes Earthquake Information and other data in real time using WebSockets and other technologies.  
By default, KyoshinEewViewer for ingen receives Earthquake Information using [JMA disaster prevention information XML (PULL)](http://xml.kishou.go.jp/xmlpull.html), which can result in a delay of approximately **1–3 minutes** between issuance and reception.  
Using DM-D.S.S can reduce this to approximately **a few seconds**, allowing information to be received as quickly as, or faster than, television and applications provided by companies.

## Pricing

|Category|Maximum monthly price|Daily price|
|---|---|---|
|Earthquake Early Warning (Forecast)|JPY 1,650/month|JPY 75/day|
|Earthquake Early Warning (Warning)|JPY 440/month|JPY 20/day|
|Earthquake and tsunami information|JPY 550/month|JPY 25/day|

(As of July 2022; only services supported by this application are shown.)

To use the service, register an account and subscribe, then link your account from the **DM-D.S.S** tab in Settings after starting the application.
SetupWizardEpilogueContent:
The initial setup is now complete.

The application can be started with the “Start” button at the bottom right.  
The Settings window can be opened with the gear icon button at the top right.  
This wizard covers only a small portion of the available settings, so feel free to customize the application to suit your preferences.

KyoshinEewViewer for ingen is still under development.  
Please contact the developer if you encounter any defects or anything that does not seem right.  
Contact information is available on the bottom tab of the Settings window.

---

## Tips for using the application
### Playing audio

This is available from the “Audio” tab of the Settings window.  
For items shown as `{int}: maximum seismic intensity`, the file name to play can be changed according to the maximum seismic intensity and similar values.  
When `C:\Sound\{int}.wav` is specified, `C:\Sound\5+.wav` is played for a maximum seismic intensity of 5 Lower.

### Using the application for recording

The tabs at the top may get in the way when using the application for streaming or recording.  
In that case, specifying a command line argument at startup launches a special mode that displays only a particular tab. (The following is a Windows example.)

- The application can be started with `KyoshinEewViewer.exe -s type`, where type is
    - `kyoshin-monitor` Strong-motion Monitor
    - `earthquake` Earthquake Information
    - `radar` Rain Cloud Radar
    - `qzss` Disaster and Crisis Management Report

When started in this mode, the buttons at the bottom left are not displayed, but they still exist, so clicking them restores the map position or opens the settings screen.

FeatureSettingsDescription: Select the features to use. When a feature is disabled, notifications and similar are not performed. Applied after restart.
MultiWindowFocusSubWindow: Focus the sub-window when switching tabs

MultiWindowResetPositions: Return all windows to their initial positions
MultiWindowResetPositionsDescription: Resets the position and size settings of separated windows
MultiWindowAboutMessage: Lets each tab be separated into its own window from the right-click menu on its icon.\nMemory and CPU/GPU usage will increase. Use this only in environments with sufficient performance headroom.
MultiWindowTrayNoticeMessage: While the multi-window feature is enabled, the "Store in the system tray when minimized" and "Store in the system tray when the window is closed" features are unavailable.
NotifyUseTrayIconDescription: (Applied after restart) Notifications are unavailable without the system tray icon.
NotifyHideWhenMinimize: Store in the system tray when minimized
NotifyHideWhenClosing: Store in the system tray when the window is closed
NotifyMultiWindowEnabledMessage: While the multi-window feature is enabled, storing the window in the system tray is unavailable.
NotifyHideToTray: Notify when stored in the system tray
NotifyUseNotificationDescription: This is an experimental implementation and may become unavailable in a future version.
NotifySwitchEqSource: When the earthquake information source changes
NotifyEewReceived: When an Earthquake Early Warning is updated
MapDisableManualControlDescription: When enabled, the home button on the main screen disappears.
MapUseMiniMapDescription: While the default display range is shown, displays a mini map of the Okinawa and Amami regions at the top left. This affects performance.
MapInertiaDescription: Scrolls smoothly with inertia after map operations and when zooming with the mouse wheel.
MapKeepRegion: Adjust the zoom level so that the entire display range stays visible when the window is resized
MapLimitMaxZoomDescription: Prevents a narrow area from being zoomed in so far during small earthquakes that the location becomes hard to identify.
SoundShowMuteButton: Show the mute button in the main window
SoundUnavailableTitle: The audio playback feature is unavailable
SoundUnavailableDescription: There may be no playback device available. A restart is required.
VoicevoxBaseUrlDescription: Do not change this unless you know what it means!\nChanging this value lets you synthesize speech using VOICEVOX running on another PC, or use voices from VOICEVOX-compatible APIs such as VOICEVOX Nemo.\nEven when the speech is synthesized on another PC, the audio itself is played by this application.
VoicevoxClearCacheImmediatelyDescription: Temporary files are still used for speech synthesis even when audio is not cached.
VoicevoxAutoCacheCleanupDescription: When automatic deletion is disabled, cache removal depends on the retention period of the OS.
VoicevoxCacheRetentionDaysDescription: The retention period is extended whenever a cached entry is used.
WorkflowRestore: Restore the saved state (reload the state from the file)
WorkflowExperimentalWarning: The workflow feature is advanced and still experimental.\nPlease read the guide at the top left carefully before using it.
WorkflowTestRunning: A test run is in progress.
ThemeEditRestore: Restore (reload the state from the file)
WindowThemeTitleSidebarColorDescription: The title bar portion is applied on Windows only.
WindowThemeIsDarkDescription: General controls such as buttons will follow the dark theme.
WindowThemeEmphasisForegroundDescription: Currently used only for the time color during Strong-motion Monitor replay.
WindowThemeWarningSubForeground: Error and warning sub text color
WindowThemeDockWarningTitleBackground: Error and warning heading background color
WindowThemeStrokeThicknessDescription: Setting this to 0 makes rendering lighter.
WindowThemeEewForecastSWaveGradient: Use a gradient for the Forecast S-wave color
WindowThemeEewWarningSWaveGradient: Use a gradient for the Warning S-wave color
WindowThemeQzssOnlyDescription: Currently used only for Disaster and Crisis Management Reports.
WindowThemeAlertLevel4: Alert Level 4 (Danger Warning / Landslide Alert Information)
KyoshinEventLevelStronger: Very strong (about seismic intensity 5-lower or above)
KyoshinMonitorSourceDescription: Strong-motion Monitor is recommended in most cases.\nSetting this to "Do not receive" stops reception from the Strong-motion Monitor entirely.
KyoshinMonitorShakeDetectionDescription: Detects shaking on the Strong-motion Monitor and zooms in automatically.
KyoshinMonitorSwitchAtShakeDetect: Switch tabs automatically when shaking is detected
KyoshinMonitorEventNotificationLevel: Shake level that triggers automatic zoom and tab switching
KyoshinMonitorShakeDisplayMode: Display mode for the shake detection area
KyoshinMonitorShakeDisplayModeDescriptio: This is experimental, so some window themes may produce hard-to-see colors.
KyoshinMonitorShakeAnimationMode: Animation for the shake detection area
KyoshinMonitorShakeAnimationModeDescript: Rendering load is highest for Pulse, then Blink, then none.
KyoshinMonitorTimeOffsetDescription: Fetches from the Strong-motion Monitor with a delay relative to the actual time.
KyoshinMonitorFetchFrequencyDescription: Receives from the Strong-motion Monitor at the specified interval.\nThis helps reduce data usage.
KyoshinMonitorForceFetchOnEew: Use a 1-second interval while receiving an EEW
KyoshinMonitorForceFetchOnShakeDetect: Use a 1-second interval while shaking is detected
KyoshinMonitorShowColorSampleDescription: "Rt intensity" is an abbreviation for real-time seismic intensity.
KyoshinMonitorMinShownIntensity: Hide observation points below a given seismic intensity
KyoshinMonitorShowInvalidateIcon: Show observation points whose data can no longer be retrieved
KyoshinMonitorShowInvalidateIconDescript: These are drawn as gray circles and given the lowest display priority.
EewAboutLink: About Earthquake Early Warnings (click to expand)
EewSwitchAtAnnounce: Switch tabs automatically when a warning is issued
EewEnableKyoshinMonitor: Receive Earthquake Early Warnings from the Strong-motion Monitor
EewEnableKyoshinMonitorDescription: If this is turned off and no other Earthquake Early Warning source is configured, Earthquake Early Warnings cannot be displayed.
EewShowDetailsDescription: Use this only if you have enough knowledge to make proper use of the information.
EewShowDetailsNote: Single-station EEWs and accuracy information will be displayed.\nHowever, this information cannot be obtained from the Strong-motion Monitor alone, so it cannot be displayed unless it is received via DM-D.S.S. or SignalNowProfessional.
EewSyncKyoshinMonitorPsWave: Match P/S-wave rendering to the Strong-motion Monitor delay
EewSyncKyoshinMonitorPsWaveDescription: Draws the spread of shaking according to the display time of the Strong-motion Monitor.
EewSyncKyoshinMonitorPsWaveNote: The circles will match the observed values of the Strong-motion Monitor, but note that they will be displayed behind real time.
EewFillWarningArea: Show warning areas on the map
EewFillWarningAreaDescription: Fills in the areas for which a warning has been issued.
EewFillForecastIntensity: Show the expected maximum seismic intensity for each area on the map
EewFillForecastIntensityDescription: Fills each area with its expected maximum seismic intensity.\nThis takes priority over warning areas.
EewSignalNowDescription: The software must be purchased, installed and running separately.
EewSignalNowLocation: Show the configured location (estimated point) on the map
EewSignalNowEstimatedArrival: Use the calculated estimated arrival time (planned)
EewSignalNowNoticeDescription: Because only the information needed to calculate the seismic intensity at the current location is transmitted, the area name and expected maximum seismic intensity are not shown and are treated as unknown.
EewSignalNowNoticeWarning: Also note that the status may show that data is being received whenever the log file can be read, even if SignalNowProfessional is not running.
EewDmdataNote: Reception via DM-D.S.S starts automatically when you have subscribed to an Earthquake Early Warning plan and are connected over WebSocket.\nThe connection status is shown next to the time information in the main window.\nIf the connection does not establish or falls back to PULL, revoke the authorization once and authorize again.
ObservationPointsAutoUpdate: Automatic update of observation point data
ObservationPointsAutoUpdateDescription: Automatically downloads new observation point data at startup.
ObservationPointsDataVersionDescription: The version of the observation point data in use.
ObservationPointsManualUpdateDescription: Updates the observation point data manually.
ObservationPointsRestartRequired: The application must be restarted to apply the update.
EarthquakeSwitchAtUpdate: Switch tabs automatically when earthquake information is updated
EarthquakeFillSokuhouDescription: Fills in the areas covered by seismic intensity information.
EarthquakeHypocenterAndIntensity: Information on hypocenter and seismic intensity
EarthquakeFillDetailDescription: Fills in the areas covered by information on hypocenter and seismic intensity.\nThis becomes heavy for large earthquakes and is not recommended on low-performance PCs.
TsunamiSwitchAtUpdate: Switch tabs automatically when tsunami information is updated
TsunamiSwitchAtUpdateDescription: Tabs do not switch when a warning is lifted or expires.
WorkflowActionMultipleParallelDescriptio: Attempts to run each action in parallel. No waiting or interruption is performed.
WorkflowActionWorkingDirectoryWatermark: If not specified, this application's directory is used.
WorkflowActionUseShellExecuteDescription: Attempts to open the file with the default application via the shell.
WorkflowActionWaitToEnd: Wait for the process to finish
WorkflowActionPlaySoundWaitDescription: Suspends the workflow until playback finishes. Useful when running another action after playback completes.
WorkflowActionPlaySoundFilePathDescripti: Plays the file specified here. Templates are available.
WorkflowActionPlaySoundPreviewDescriptio: Plays a preview. Variables are not expanded.
WorkflowActionVoicevoxWaitDescription: Suspends the workflow until speech finishes. Useful when running another action after speech completes.
WorkflowActionVoicevoxSequentialDescript: Splits the text by line breaks, synthesizes them all at once, then speaks them in order. If synthesis cannot keep up, speech may break off at the split boundaries, but the cache is used more effectively.
WorkflowActionVoicevoxInterruptPreviousD: If a new playback request arrives while audio from this action is playing, the ongoing playback is interrupted and the new audio is played. In sequential speech mode, the current segment is interrupted and the remaining segments are also cancelled.
WorkflowTriggerUpdateContinuousDescripti:
When on, triggers whenever an update exists at each update check (roughly every 10 minutes).
When off, triggers only once when an update is found.
WorkflowTriggerIssueUpdateConditionDescr: Conditions for triggering by the issuance or update of the information itself.
WorkflowTriggerLevelMatchDescription:
By default, higher-level events are also triggered.
Enabling this option allows the action to run only at that level.
WorkflowTriggerEewWarningContractNote: Currently triggered only if you have a DM-D.S.S Earthquake Early Warning (Warning) contract.
WorkflowTriggerOnReceiveDescription: When information is received, regardless of whether it is an update
WorkflowTriggerOnMaxIntensityChangeDescr: When the maximum intensity changes. Also triggered on newly received information.
WorkflowTriggerEewIntensityMagnitudeCond: Sets the intensity and magnitude conditions.
WorkflowTriggerEewHypotheticalNote: Note: For hypothetical hypocenter parameters, the magnitude is M1.0.
WorkflowTriggerEewMoreAccurateDescriptio: Triggered when only the information is updated from a higher-precision source without the report number changing.
WorkflowTriggerChangeConditionDescriptio: If this overlaps with other conditions, it is triggered separately for each condition.
WorkflowTriggerEewWarningLevelReachedDes: Triggered once when the Earthquake Early Warning (Forecast) reaches the warning level.
WorkflowTriggerEewIntensityIncreaseDescr:
Also triggered when an intensity is assigned to a previously unknown predicted intensity.
Not recommended when using SNP integration.
WorkflowTriggerEewIntensityDecreaseDescr:
Also triggered when the predicted intensity becomes unknown.
Not recommended when using SNP integration.
WorkflowTriggerQzssNewReceivedDescriptio: When a non-duplicate disaster/crisis report is received
WorkflowTriggerQzssNankaiCompleted: Nankai Trough Earthquake Extra Information reception complete
WorkflowTriggerQzssNankaiCompletedDescri: Not triggered if Nankai Trough Earthquake Information is not enabled under Type.
WorkflowTriggerTsunamiLevelMatchOnly: Run only on an exact match
WorkflowTriggerTsunamiIssuedDescription: When tsunami information is issued from an unissued state
WorkflowTriggerTsunamiUpgradedDescriptio: When switched to a higher-level warning
WorkflowTriggerTsunamiDowngradedDescript: When the warning level is lowered or lifted
WorkflowTriggerTsunamiOtherUpdateDescrip: When information other than the above is updated, such as a change in the number of areas
WorkflowTriggerShakeLevelMatchOnly: Run only when the level matches exactly
WorkflowTriggerShakePeakRegionExpansionD:
Sets the behavior when the number of areas observing the maximum shaking level increases.
・Do nothing: Does not fire when areas expand
・Areas only: Fires only when a new area is added
・Include sub-areas: Also fires when sub-areas increase
DmdataUseWebSocketDescription: Consumes one WebSocket connection to improve real-time performance.
DmdataPullMultiply: Fetch interval multiplier for PULL mode
DmdataPullMultiplyDescription: Increasing it reduces the load on the server.
DmdataReceiveTrainingDescription: If connected via WebSocket, reconnection is required to apply this.
DmdataUseRedundancyDescription: Connects to multiple endpoints in Tokyo and Osaka to improve reliability.
